summary: Four confirmed bugs found by reading every dashboard page and its API contract. (1) OverviewPage calls .filter() on an object — the /cube/diagnostics endpoint returns a Record<string,CheckResult> but OverviewPage types it as DiagnosticsCheck[] and calls diagData.filter(), which throws TypeError and crashes the page. (2) DiagnosticsCheckCard CHECK_GUIDANCE is keyed on old names (missing_supplier, missing_category, etc.) that do not match the actual check names returned by DataQualityDiagnostics.run_all() (missing_supplier_name, uncategorised_spend, etc.) — guidance text is always blank. (3) The backend pipeline uses stage name 'promoting' which is not in the frontend PIPELINE_STAGES array, so all stage icons get stuck on pending during harmonisation and categorisation. (4) After the pipeline finishes, the user must manually click 'Run Recommendations Engine' — recommendations should auto-generate as the final pipeline stage. This sprint fixes all four and adds an Upload nav link to the sidebar.

decisions.diagnostics_fix_location: Fix on the frontend only — change OverviewPage to use Object.values() instead of array typing. No API change needed.
decisions.guidance_keys: Update CHECK_GUIDANCE in DiagnosticsCheckCard to use the actual check names from DataQualityDiagnostics.run_all(). Add DISPLAY_NAMES map for humanized titles.
decisions.recommendations_autorun: Add a 5th stage to _run_pipeline in backend/app/routers/ingestion.py: after building the cube, run RecommendationEngine and store recommendations_json on the engagement row. Frontend gets a new PIPELINE_STAGES entry for 'recommendations'.
decisions.stage_name_mapping: Add early-return in getStageStatus for 'promoting' stage: ingesting=done, harmonising=active, all others=pending.

existing_tables.engagements: Has recommendations_json TEXT column — used by GET /recommendations and populated by POST /run. After this sprint, _run_pipeline will also write to it directly.
existing_tables.pipeline_jobs: Tracks stage name as TEXT. Backend sets stage='promoting' which frontend does not recognise. Will also get stage='recommendations'.
existing_tables.transactions: Queried by diagnostics and recommendations engine. engagement_id scoped.

userStories.title: Fix OverviewPage diagnostics crash
userStories.description: In frontend/src/pages/dashboard/OverviewPage.tsx, the query for /cube/diagnostics is typed as DiagnosticsCheck[] but the API returns a Record<string, {status, pct, description}> object. When data loads, calling diagData.filter(...) throws TypeError: diagData.filter is not a function and crashes the overview page. Fix by changing the query type to Record<string, {status?: string}>, defaulting to {}, computing redCount with Object.values(), and adding retry:false plus .catch(() => ({})) so a diagnostics failure does not crash the page.

userStories.title: Fix pipeline stage display for 'promoting' backend stage name
userStories.description: In frontend/src/pages/ingest/UploadPage.tsx, the getStageStatus function calls PIPELINE_STAGES.findIndex(s => s.key === jobStatus.stage). The backend pipeline sets stage='promoting' but PIPELINE_STAGES has keys: ingesting, harmonising, categorising, building_cube. So findIndex returns -1 for 'promoting' and all stages appear as pending. Add an early-return in getStageStatus: when stage is 'promoting', return 'done' for ingesting, 'active' for harmonising, and 'pending' for all others. The existing early-return for 'queued' status is at the top of the function — add the 'promoting' special case right after it.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit file: frontend/src/pages/ingest/UploadPage.tsx — in getStageStatus, after the 'if (!jobStatus || jobStatus.status === queued) return pending' line, add: if (jobStatus.stage === 'promoting') { return stageKey === 'ingesting' ? 'done' : stageKey === 'harmonising' ? 'active' : 'pending' }
Run: cd frontend && npm run build — should succeed

userStories.title: Auto-run recommendations as final pipeline stage
userStories.description: In backend/app/routers/ingestion.py, the _run_pipeline function ends at stage='building_cube'. Add a 5th stage 'recommendations' that runs RecommendationEngine and stores the JSON result in engagements.recommendations_json. This mirrors the existing POST /recommendations/run handler in backend/app/routers/recommendations.py. The config object and src_engine are already in scope. Note: import json is not currently at the top of ingestion.py — add it. The _portfolio_summary attribute is accessed as rec_engine._portfolio_summary (confirmed from recommendations.py). On the frontend, add a 5th PIPELINE_STAGES entry { key: 'recommendations', label: 'Generating Recommendations' }.

userStories.title: Fix avg payment days display and null-safety in PaymentTermsPage
userStories.description: In frontend/src/pages/dashboard/PaymentTermsPage.tsx, avg_payment_days is the result of AVG() in SQL so it is a float. Also verify all null-safety on avg_payment_days in the computeSupplierWc function and daysCls-equivalent expressions in SupplierPage. Read both files before editing.
